task_completed.label: Task completed?
task_completed.text: Did the agent complete the task the user asked for?

correct_result.label: Correct result?
correct_result.text: Is the end result correct: the changes the agent made to orders, refunds or exchanges, and the answer it gave the user?

grounded.label: Grounded in tool evidence?
grounded.text: Is every fact the agent told the user (amounts, items, order statuses) shown in the tool results of this conversation?

followed_instructions.label: Followed instructions?
followed_instructions.text: Did the agent follow its policy at every step, including authenticating the user before acting on an account and getting explicit confirmation before any change?

correct_tools.label: Used correct tools?
correct_tools.text: Did the agent call the tools the task needed, with the right arguments?

unsupported_claim.label: Introduced unsupported claim?
unsupported_claim.text: Did the agent tell the user something (an amount, an item, an order status, a policy rule) that the tool results and the policy do not support?

unnecessary_actions.label: Unnecessary/destructive actions?
unnecessary_actions.text: Did the agent perform an action that the user did not ask for or that the policy forbids?
